mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases above 3% do not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases by >0.5% do not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of observed periods despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side dynamics, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases by >1% do not correlate with subsequent positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease by >100,000 does not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline by >2% does not correlate with subsequent negative returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease by >0.25% does not correlate with subsequent positive returns (Pearson correlation p > 0.05).
